description: Frozen trial grid for phase 1: 6 genuinely distinct registered rules (3 families x 2 frozen param variants, see quant/strategy/rules-v002.js). Metrics are net of the frozen cost model (commission 2bps + slippage 5bps per unit turnover). Duplicating a rule N times is rejected at runtime (variance<=epsilon -> null). Grid changes require trialsVersion bump + rules version bump + human review.
